_intent: Define target PCB outline: 70mm x 45mm centered at (X=140, Y=100)
_rule: Use board.set_size for fixed enclosures. (Use board.fit_outline only if dynamically wrapping placed parts)

_intent: Place USB connector along left perimeter edge
_rule: Connector opening MUST face outward toward board edge (rotation: 180 on left edge)

_intent: Lock J1 in place to anchor the mechanical boundary
_rule: Always lock edge connectors immediately to prevent accidental movement

_intent: Place D1 Schottky diode inline with USB positive rail
_rule: Place reverse-polarity/rectifier diode immediately downstream of connector pin

_intent: Place C1 10uF bulk input capacitor for LDO
_rule: Place within 1-3mm of regulator VIN pin to suppress transient supply ripple

_intent: Place U1 AMS1117-3.3 SOT-223 regulator on top edge
_rule: Large heatsink tab (Pin 4) MUST face outward toward board edge (rotation: 270) for thermal dissipation

_intent: Place C3 100nF ceramic decoupling capacitor directly adjacent to LDO output
_rule: High-frequency 100nF decoupling capacitors MUST sit closer to the IC pin than bulk electrolytic caps

_intent: Place C2 10uF bulk output capacitor for +3V3 rail stability
_rule: Place directly downstream of regulator VOUT pin for low ESR transient stabilization

_intent: Place U2 ESP32-WROOM-32 module on center-right zone
_rule: PCB antenna MUST point toward outer right edge with NO copper planes underneath for maximum RF range

_intent: Place C4 100nF decoupling capacitor directly adjacent to MCU 3V3 power pin (Pin 2)
_rule: Decoupling capacitor loop inductance MUST be minimized: distance to power pin < 2.5mm

_intent: Place R1 10k EN pull-up resistor next to U2.EN pin
_rule: Keep reset and boot pull-up resistors adjacent to their respective IC pads

_intent: Place R2 10k IO0 pull-up resistor next to U2.IO0 pin
_rule: Maintain short routing stubs on high-impedance strapping lines

_intent: Place SW1 BOOT tactile push-button switch in accessible lower-left quadrant
_rule: Keep user buttons in clear accessible perimeter zones away from tall or hot components

_intent: Purge orphaned traces, verify closed board outline, and check netclass widths
_rule: Execute board.prep_for_route immediately prior to launching Freerouting autorouter

_intent: Run automated headless DRC check to guarantee 0 design rule violations
_rule: DRC check runs via kicad-cli and verifies clearances, track widths, and annular rings

_usage_guide: Use board.fit_outline instead of board.set_size when you want KiCad to automatically shrink-wrap the board around placed components with a safety margin (in mm).
Use footprint.move for fine-grained coordinate nudging or flipping a footprint between top (F.Cu) and bottom (B.Cu) layers.
Use footprint.rotate to change footprint orientation in-place without altering its X/Y coordinates.
Use footprint.set_field to update component values, MPNs, or custom properties directly inside PCB memory.
name: Value

_usage_guide: Use track.add to route critical high-current traces, differential pairs, or power rails manually.
Use via.add to drop stitching vias connecting top and bottom ground planes for low return-path inductance.
Use track.set_width to dynamically adjust trace width by UUID without redrawing coordinates.
Use net.delete_routing to clear routed copper traces for a specific net before rerouting.
Use item.delete for targeted deletion of any specific track, via, zone, or drawing by its unique UUID.
